reason: I already pay a monthly fee for AngelSense and I'm watching every dollar. A $249 camera plus $19.99 a month for live video is another bill on top of the one I have, and I'd need to be sure it does more than what I've got before I switch or add it.
objection: Another monthly fee on top of everything else. I don't yet know whether this replaces my tracker or sits next to it, and paying for both is not something I can afford.
would_change_my_mind: A clear side-by-side showing it does what my current tracker does for less money, or a trial month where I can cancel with no device lock-in.
